description: This is a modern 'Pods View' dashboard for your Kubernetes cluster(s). Made for kube-prometheus-stack and take advantage of the latest Grafana features. GitHub repository: https://github.com/dotdc/grafana-dashboards-kubernetes

targets.expr: avg(sum by (node, cpu) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!~"idle|iowait|steal"}[$__rate_interval]))) by (node) * on(node) group_left(node_short, nodegroup_short, label_kubernetes_io_arch, label_node_kubernetes_io_instance_type, label_tenancy_entigo_com_zone, label_tenancy_entigo_com_zone_pool, label_eks_amazonaws_com_capacity_type, label_topology_kubernetes_io_zone) label_replace(label_replace(kube_node_labels, "nodegroup_short", "$1", "label_eks_amazonaws_com_nodegroup", "(.+)-[^-]+$"), "node_short", "$1", "node", "([^.]+)\\..*")

(sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{}) by (node) / sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{}) by (node)) * 100 * on(node) group_left(node_short, nodegroup_short, label_kubernetes_io_arch, label_node_kubernetes_io_instance_type, label_tenancy_entigo_com_zone, label_tenancy_entigo_com_zone_pool, label_eks_amazonaws_com_capacity_type, label_topology_kubernetes_io_zone) label_replace(label_replace(kube_node_labels, "nodegroup_short", "$1", "label_eks_amazonaws_com_nodegroup", "(.+)-[^-]+$"), "node_short", "$1", "node", "([^.]+)\\..*")

sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!=""}[$__rate_interval])) by (namespace)
+ on (namespace)
(sum(rate(windows_container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container_id!=""}[$__rate_interval]) * on (container_id) group_left (container, pod, namespace) max by ( container, container_id, pod, namespace) (kube_pod_container_info{container_id!=""}) OR kube_namespace_created{} * 0) by (namespace))

sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{image!=""}) by (namespace)
+ on (namespace)
(sum(windows_container_memory_usage_commit_bytes{container_id!=""} * on (container_id) group_left (container, pod, namespace) max by ( container, container_id, pod, namespace) (kube_pod_container_info{container_id!=""}) OR kube_namespace_created{} * 0) by (namespace))

sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod) / sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", pod!="", resource="cpu"}) by (pod)
sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", pod!="", image!=""}) by (pod) / sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", pod!="", resource="memory"}) by (pod)

sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod) / sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", pod!="", resource="cpu"}) by (pod)
sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", pod!="", image!=""}) by (pod) / sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$namespace", pod!="", resource="memory"}) by (pod)
